label: FuelTaxRate
description: A motor-fuel tax rate — one jurisdiction, one quarter (IFTA diesel rate + surcharge as served by fuel.rootz.global, source iftach.org). Epistery-published vocabulary; schema.org has no tax-rate type. Rates change quarterly, so the period is part of the object's identity.

trust.note: Reserved — jurisdictional rate proof points as the market defines them.
